title: Anomaly Tagging & Remediation Catalog for Latency and Error Signals
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a pragmatic, searchable catalog that tags runtime anomalies (timeouts, overload, model errors, and transport-level failures) with root-cause signals and prescriptive remediation steps. This ticket covers taxonomy, enrichment rules for tracing hooks and logs, metric/ingest pipeline adjustments, and dashboard panels to surface prioritized triage paths for SREs and product engineers.

Scope:
- Define canonical failure classes with example signatures: client_timeouts (HTTP 408 / gRPC DEADLINE_EXCEEDED), upstream_timeouts (model KV fetch stalls), overload (queue growth + CPU/GPU pressure), model_rejection (generation aborted / nan outputs), rpc_errors (4xx/5xx mapping), resource_errors (OOM, CUDA driver faults).
- Author enrichment rules to attach a taxonomy label to traces at ingest time using existing trace-hook middleware: sample rate policy, span tag heuristics (status_code, error.message, kv_cache_miss), and a confidence score.
- Add log/metric pipeline extractors: normalize error.reason, map gRPC codes to standard categories, and emit anomaly.event metrics (anomaly_type, confidence, admission_path).
- Dashboard work: new Grafana panels in "Runtime Triage" folder: stacked heatmap of anomaly_type by service, top 10 trace examples per anomaly class, SLO-exposure gauge (requests/min above SLO threshold attributed by class), and a remediation playbook widget linking to runbooks.
- Alerts & playbooks: define alert thresholds for grouped anomaly spikes (e.g., >3x baseline for 2 min) and wire to PagerDuty with automatic context (example traces, recent model variants, capacity metrics).

Acceptance criteria:
1) Taxonomy doc published in Confluence with 10+ example signatures and mapping matrix to HTTP/gRPC codes.
2) Trace ingestion enrichment runs for 30% of traffic in staging and attaches taxonomy labels and confidence.
3) Pipeline emits anomaly.event metrics with consistent tag keys and passes CI linting.
4) Grafana Runtime Triage dashboard added with panels and links; UX reviewed by SRE/PM and approved.
5) Playbooks added for top 3 anomaly classes with reproducible first-reply steps.

Implementation notes:
- Use tracer hook middleware in runtime v2 to add a derived_span_tag "anomaly.class" and "anomaly.confidence". Keep overhead target <2% latency p50.
- For log/metric extraction use existing Fluent Bit pipeline; add Lua filter for gRPC status normalization.
- Dashboard panels should allow toggling model variant and region; reuse templating variables from existing runtime dashboards.
- Start with conservative sampling (2% live, 30% staging) and increase after verification.

Risks & mitigations:
- False positives flooding SRE: mitigate with confidence score threshold and aggregation windowing.
- Privacy: ensure no PII included in trace excerpts; redact request payloads in examples.
- Performance impact: verify enrichment CPU cost and fail open (no tagging) on pressure.

Notes for follow-ups: link this ticket to a later rollout task for increasing sampling, and to a separate UX ticket for in-console playbook rendering.
